name: Monkey Chasers VR
summary:
Become Monkey and Reject Humanity!

Run, climb, and jump in VR using the unique Gorilla Tag locomotion method that only needs the movement of your hands and arms. Push off a surface to jump around the environment and maps.

There are five different maps:
The Jungle is the main map where you can jump from one branch to another. 
The Monkey Store has cosmetics as such to put on your monkey.  Zero Gravity is a map where you can swim and float without gravity. The Beach has slides and places to relax in the sun
